_help: Texts of the practical file's Certificate and Acknowledgement pages (Padhaku Practical File Maker). Placeholders: {name} {class} {section} {roll} {school} {session} {teacher} {subject} {code}. A new line starts a new paragraph. Empty = the app's built-in text.
certificate:
This is to certify that {name}, a student of Class {class} {section} (Roll No. {roll}) of {school}, has successfully completed the practical work in {subject} ({code}) as prescribed by the Central Board of Secondary Education for the session {session}.
The practicals recorded in this file were done by the student under my guidance.
certificate_hi:
प्रमाणित किया जाता है कि {school} की कक्षा {class} {section} (रोल नं. {roll}) के विद्यार्थी {name} ने सत्र {session} के लिए केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड द्वारा निर्धारित {subject} ({code}) का प्रायोगिक कार्य सफलतापूर्वक पूरा किया है।
इस फ़ाइल में दर्ज प्रैक्टिकल विद्यार्थी ने मेरे मार्गदर्शन में किए हैं।
